newsHighlights.title: Strokes of genius: Where innovation takes shape
newsHighlights.summary: Shanghai's Putuo district is building on its commercial roots to become a hub for innovation along the Shanghai-Nanjing corridor.
newsHighlights.translation: 上海普陀区正依托商业根基，打造上海—南京走廊上的创新高地。

newsHighlights.title: Wang Yi says openness and pragmatism define China-Netherlands ties

newsHighlights.translation: 王毅表示，开放与务实是中荷关系的鲜明特征。

newsHighlights.title: Xi hails China-Pakistan milestone
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi hailed the latest development as a new milestone in the all-weather cooperative partnership between China and Pakistan.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席称赞最新进展是中巴全天候合作伙伴关系的新里程碑。

newsHighlights.title: Nation further opens up vast market to imports

newsHighlights.translation: 中国正进一步扩大市场开放，为全球企业及其员工提供新机遇。

newsHighlights.title: What will shape the China-US AI future? | Short documentary
newsHighlights.summary: A short documentary explores what will shape the future of artificial intelligence cooperation and competition between China and the United States.
newsHighlights.translation: 一部短片探讨了什么将塑造中美人工智能合作与竞争的未来。

quote.quote: The single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place.
quote.author: George Bernard Shaw
quote.translation: 沟通中最大的问题，是误以为沟通已经发生了。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒职场人：不要以为发过邮件、开过会就等于沟通到位。真正的沟通以对方理解并能够行动为标准，需要确认、反馈和复述。

pattern.pattern: A is building on X to become Y（A 以 X 为基础，发展成为 Y）
pattern.example: Shanghai's Putuo district is building on its commercial roots to become a hub for innovation.
pattern.translation: 上海普陀区正依托商业根基，发展成为创新高地。
pattern.usage: 用于描述个人或组织依托既有优势实现升级转型。职场中可用于自我介绍或汇报："I am building on my experience in sales to become a project manager."（我正依托销售经验，转型成为项目经理。）

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）：描述从过去延续至今的变化
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词，强调过去发生的事情对现在仍有影响，常与 in the past few decades、so far、recently 等时间状语连用。新闻中常用它来描述国家、企业或行业的持续发展。
examples: China has come a long way in the past few decades.
The nation has further opened up its vast market to imports.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第一个音节 PRAG-，读 /præɡ/ 时口型扁平，/æ/ 类似“爱”的前半段；后缀 -matism 读 /mətɪzəm/，中间音节弱读为 /mə/。注意不要读成 pra-GMA-tism。
examples: Openness and pragmatism define the relationship.
We need pragmatism, not empty talk, in the workplace.

reading.title: Where Innovation Takes Shape: Communication at Work
reading.content:
Shanghai's Putuo district is building on its commercial roots to become a hub for innovation. Along the Shanghai-Nanjing corridor, traditional office spaces are evolving into shared workspaces where engineers, designers and entrepreneurs work side by side. Advances in robotics and artificial intelligence are changing not only what people produce, but also how teams communicate.

Managers say the most valuable skill in this new environment is clear communication. When a robotics startup pitches an idea to investors, it must translate complex technology into simple language. When Chinese and foreign partners sign a deal, they need openness and pragmatism rather than slogans.

Experts note that the country has come a long way in building innovation clusters. But technology alone is not enough. Trust, dialogue and honest feedback still shape a company's success. As one engineer put it, innovation takes shape where people are willing to listen — and to be understood.
reading.translation:
上海普陀区正依托商业根基，打造创新高地。沿着沪宁走廊，传统的办公空间正在演变为共享工作区，工程师、设计师和企业家并肩工作。机器人与人工智能的进步，不仅改变了人们生产什么，也改变了团队沟通的方式。

管理者表示，新环境中最有价值的技能是清晰的沟通。当一家机器人初创公司向投资人推介创意时，必须把复杂的技术翻译成简单的语言；当中外伙伴签署协议时，他们需要的是开放与务实，而非口号。

专家指出，中国在建设创新集群方面已走过很长的路。但仅有技术还不够。信任、对话和坦诚的反馈依然决定着一家公司的成败。正如一位工程师所说：创新在人们愿意倾听、也愿意被理解的地方成型。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily《Strokes of genius: Where innovation takes shape》《Nation further opens up vast market to imports》及 CGTN《Wang Yi says openness and pragmatism define China-Netherlands ties》等今日新闻改写，用于英语学习。
